scope: B2 territorial governance on disposable WordPress/MariaDB; fictitious public criteria, local SSO links only, no economic or production admission
checks: Normal activation creates no territorial schema or default policy
Members cannot install territory schema
Territory installation is explicit and idempotent
No criteria or countries are silently created
Members cannot publish their own examination criteria
French criteria and named localities are persisted exactly
Replaying an identical policy keeps one immutable version
Changing registered criteria requires a new explicit version
Private declaration refuses guest
Private declaration refuses unlinked
Private declaration refuses admin
Approved public presentation does not certify a principal territory
Unknown locality is not inferred from a country
Locality in a different country is refused
Declaration remains pending without any approval
Pending territory cannot open a local session
A failed opening leaves no policy binding or session revision
Creator cannot approve their own territorial declaration
Concurrent decisions commit one revision and reject the other
Reviewed matching local territory prepares opening without Hub acknowledgement
Territorial policy version is frozen with the session
National coorganization accepts different examined localities in the same country
Examined creator in another country is not admitted to local session
Different examined localities are refused by a local session
A changed declaration suspends future territorial eligibility pending review
Reviewed matching participant is admitted only for future contributions
Revocation retains a motivated private decision
Private recourse does not silently readmit a creator
Members cannot read the moderator examination queue
Only moderators receive recourse text in their bounded review
Reexamination versions the approval without replacing the frozen policy
Owner withdrawal clears private current locality and future approval
International session has no invented territorial restriction
New criteria never rewrite earlier frozen session policy
Internal binding refuses a caller outside the session transaction
Corrupted policy cannot be replayed as a valid immutable examination
Restoring exact criteria preserves the frozen policy hash
Journal failure rolls back declaration and previous approval together
Every territorial revision has one immutable journal decision
Nontransactional territorial schema is refused
Compatible schema restoration preserves decisions
No economic operation, default retention or public score is introduced
